shared_elements: band or grid of repeated rectilinear units
justification: A shows a clearly figural procession scene — a bactrian camel in profile led by robed human figures carrying vessels, beneath a border band of rosettes — whereas B shows only an abstract lattice or brick-like grid of rectangles with hatched lines and no identifiable figures. The only correspondence is the very generic presence of shallow incised repeated units on a carved surface, which any tradition could produce independently.
